raw_request: Initialize one advisory AppSDK Guidance surface for the agent-plugins repository, covering agent-tui, agent-memory, Teams, and dsh-concurrency-limit while preserving each child project's own lifecycle truth.
understood_objective: The root Guidance binds every task to the real resource/function/mainline/verification context, requires notes during debug exploration, and accumulates verified context without forcing unnecessary workflow depth for small changes.
acceptance_criteria: Root AppSDK 0.1.6 governance and Guidance compile and verify from a clean owner worktree.

Feature flow requires requirements -> map_check -> implementation -> candidate -> validation -> review -> integration -> cleanup; architecture, map_update, effectiveness, and promotion are explicit optional bypass nodes selected by risk and scope.
Debug flow requires orient -> explore -> resolve -> candidate -> validation -> review -> integration -> cleanup; orient binds the real function map and gates and explore appends run notes.
agent-tui, agent-memory, Teams, and dsh-concurrency-limit are represented with truthful source/governance status; agent-memory remains pending while absent from the root baseline.
Task closeout reviews AGENTS.md, local Skills, and MEMORY.md before removing only the owner's clean worktree after required receipts.
non_goals: Do not modify deepseek-harness or an ignored opencode reference.
Do not replace child AppSDK maps, lifecycle records, Active, Protected, evidence, claims, mailboxes, journals, or hashes.
Do not activate a missing agent-memory path or manufacture lifecycle evidence.
assumptions: The current repository root is the project root and origin/main is the clean baseline.
The root maps bind cross-project ownership while child maps remain canonical for implementation.
AppSDK binary byte identity is not a Guidance admission gate.
